title: Banana French Toast
notes: Make the blueberry compote, cashew cream and batter the night before and store in the fridge for a really easy gourmet breakfast or brunch the next day.

methodSections.heading: Blueberry Compote
steps: Combine all the ingredients in a saucepan and cook, stirring regularly, until the blueberries have released their juice and a thick liquor has developed.

methodSections.heading: Cashew Cream
steps: Soak the cashews in water overnight.
Drain the cashews and add to a blender with all remaining ingredients and blend until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Cashew Crumble
steps: Roast the cashews in the oven at 180°C (350°F) for around 5 minutes or until golden.
Create a crumble by crushing in a pestle and mortar or pulsing lightly in a food processor.

methodSections.heading: Batter
steps: Place all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Assembly
steps: Place the batter in a large bowl. Slice the sourdough. Heat a large heavy frying pan to a medium high heat.
Soak a slice of bread in the batter. Melt some vegan butter in the pan. Remove the bread from the batter and scrape any excess off before pan frying for 3-5 minutes per side or until golden brown.
Repeat the process for each slice and serve topped with the blueberry compote, cashew crumble, drizzled with cashew cream and with maple syrup on the side.
